text:
maria gonzalez: Quick request — I need to swap Sunday 2026-03-22 oncall (08:00-20:00 PT). Family thing came up. I can take Monday night in exchange if that helps. Main risks: nightly batch hits at 14:00 PT and can spike memory on serving nodes; there
is a canary deploy Sat 22:00 PT (low risk) but please watch p50/p95 latency during the window. Prefer a 15 min overlap for handoff.

 daniel kim: I can do 08:00-14:00 PT. I'll watch the batch window and keep an eye on memory. Can we do a quick handoff call at 07:45 PT?

 lee chen: I can take 14:00-20:00 PT. Confirming pager ownership will be updated? Also want the JVM heap/runbook link for quick access.

 oncall-bot: Swap request created by maria gonzalez — @daniel kim + @lee chen assigned provisional (use `ri oncall` to finalize).

 maria gonzalez: Thanks both. Handoff notes: do not restart model-serving nodes during 13:00-15:00 PT (batch + cache warm). If you need to escalate: infra-pager -> oncall@redwood.com; pager phone +1-555-0142. Runbooks: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall_serving (search 'model-serving-memory'). Handy commands: `ri ops tail logs --service serving --since 1h` and `ri ops dump kv-cache --node <id>`.

daniel kim: Got it. I'll set a reminder at 13:50 PT to check latency and cache hit rate. Any scheduled maintenance Sunday? I remember GPU maintenance Monday.

 maria gonzalez: No Sunday maintenance. GPU maintenance is Mon 02:00-05:00 PT — outside both of your windows. Also: if p95 > 600ms for 2 consecutive minutes, follow runbook step 4 and switch to fallback model 'llama-mini-ttl'.

 lee chen: Confirmed. I'll be primary after handoff and will join Zoom at 07:40 PT for the handover. @daniel kim, please post a short confirmation in this thread after you finish the swap.

daniel kim: Will do. Adding the command I used to create the formal handoff in tooling for reference:
```
ri oncall handoff create --from maria --to daniel --start 2026-03-22T15:00-07:00 --notes "batch window, canary watch"
```

 maria gonzalez: Perfect — thanks @daniel kim and @lee chen :heart:  Please ping if anything unexpected pops up.

daniel kim: All set on my side. I'll post a short "handoff complete" after the 07:45 call :thumbsup:
